Name: Direction
Description: Specifies whether the macro port is used for input or output connections. Determines the flow of data into or out of the macro node.

Flubs.Name: Input
Flubs.Description: Designates the port as an input, allowing data to be received by the macro node.

Flubs.Name: Output
Flubs.Description: Designates the port as an output, allowing data to be sent from the macro node.

Name: Display
Description: Defines the type of data visualized or represented by the macro port. This helps users identify the nature of the connection in the node graph.

Flubs.Name: Heightfield
Flubs.Description: Represents terrain elevation data, typically used for heightmaps.

Flubs.Name: Mask
Flubs.Description: Represents mask data, used for isolating or selecting specific regions in the terrain.

Flubs.Name: Color
Flubs.Description: Represents color data, used for visual effects or texture information.

Name: Fallback
Description: When the given input fails or is intended to short-circuit, return the selected map.

Flubs.Name: Null
Flubs.Description: Return a null value. May cause node to be disrupted, but needed for Switch and other mechanisms.
